scope: Approved combined plan plus later explicit hot-path/legacy-removal redirect and long-run L2 approval

rows.requirement: Measured critical path, backend coverage, transfers and 20x feasibility gap
rows.finding: Separate device unions and CPU sampling exist; current kernels alone exceed the entire 20x budget. Sampling and before-API gaps do not provide exclusive attribution of every named initialization/runtime/output phase.
rows.required_evidence: Preserve measured ceiling/gap; phase attribution must partition exclusive CPU time and dependencies without adding overlapping spans.

rows.requirement: Pinned local solver, compiler/architecture/dependencies, out-of-tree installed artifacts
rows.finding: Public resident-build snapshots the explicit local provider and hashes local edits. Duplicate vendored provider was removed. Current full build is the next evidence, not historical objects.
rows.required_evidence: Current complete build receipts, matching toolchain, loader/provider identity and install consumer verification.

rows.requirement: Differential solver equivalence against pinned PoisFFT
rows.finding: Maintained differential covers both approximation orders, ghost preservation and nondefault/cross-stream ordering. Recent identical-input application evidence establishes reached FD2 only.
rows.required_evidence: Run maintained differential on current provider; keep independent FD4 residual/manufactured-solution validation distinct from agreement with PoisFFT.

rows.requirement: Caller-owned storage domains, borrowed contexts and unmanaged publication
rows.finding: Storage and context lifetime are separate, using one scoped coherence engine. The supported application adapter retains a domain across RK stages and timesteps.
rows.required_evidence: Current public-build reproduction plus maintained lifecycle suite; application results do not prove every generic lifetime case.

rows.requirement: Read copies preserve originals; overlapping writes invalidate only affected regions
rows.finding: Replica state uses regional unions/differences; read-only frame observe does not end the domain. The CUDA chain fixture checks mixed host/device access.
rows.required_evidence: Fresh memory milestone must inspect physical copy ledgers as well as numerical values for unchanged alternating readers and partial writes.

rows.requirement: Generations, views, allocation swaps, unknown mutations and lazy zero-trip activation
rows.finding: Generic checked epochs and generation-checked views exist. The ELMM adapter proves its MOVE_ALLOC exchange and follows physical allocations. Unknown source descriptor changes retain retirement boundaries.
rows.required_evidence: Re-run same-address replacement, overlapping/rebased views, swaps, SAVE and unallocated zero-trip cases at release scope.

rows.requirement: Pending completion, eviction, queued readers and failure before/after submission
rows.finding: Runtime waits on ordered users, budgets allocations/workspaces and poisons uncertain/started failures; source replay is prohibited. Current application success does not exercise all failure modes.
rows.required_evidence: Current domain, queued lifetime, eviction and failure-injection suites.

rows.requirement: Disable unsafe native-owner shortcuts under live coherent domains
rows.finding: Live/detached domains veto contextless native-hint lookup and learning; test source explicitly covers this case.
rows.required_evidence: Current native-hint/generation/path invalidation regression results.

rows.requirement: One checked task graph; data, anti/output, lifetime, control, IEEE and effect dependencies
rows.finding: Generic graph verification and deterministic scheduling exist. The supported resident application uses explicit source adapters and checked numerical entries; this is not proof that the entire application is one generic checked graph.
rows.required_evidence: Complete migration of production selection to graph authority; dependency verifier and control/IEEE/observable-effect regression results for every emitted schedule.

rows.requirement: Regroup independent native work within original control regions
rows.finding: Ready-list motion and native grouping have generic implementations. Native effects and control regions remain boundaries. The whole channel path is explicitly adapted, not evidence of arbitrary interprocedural regrouping.
rows.required_evidence: Generic host/GPU/host motion examples plus reached application profiles showing reduced dependencies/idle time.

rows.requirement: Residency and execution not limited by source-unit windows
rows.finding: Resident extraction groups consecutive nests without the old 32-loop cutoff. Ordinary analyze_offload still validates max_interval in 1..4 and enumerates those windows plus the whole region; that legacy path remains publicly selectable.
rows.required_evidence: Remove/migrate ordinary interval-placement policy; retain budgeted graph search without dropping tasks or cutting storage lifetime.

rows.requirement: All intended hot stages execute on GPU and improve complete-process wall time
rows.finding: Selected baseline short ledgers show 31/28 required GPU procedures, zero generated CPU numerical events and zero CPU FFTW plans. Clean primary medians are 3.83x/3.73x native.
rows.required_evidence: Fresh public-build strict cases, backend ledgers and complete-process release comparison; generated files alone do not establish execution.

rows.requirement: Typed external-device contract, stream/workspace/completion, no replay after submission
rows.finding: Checked external transactions supply typed views and stream; ABI exposes started/failure status. C++ boundary catches exceptions.
rows.required_evidence: Current contract tests for rejection, partial submission, wrong generation/layout, workspace exhaustion and completion.

rows.requirement: Correct FD2/FD4, lengths/boundaries, dense origins, Phi interior only, RHS/halos retained
rows.finding: Configuration and layout checks exist; current primary reached pressure operator is FD2. Passing primary results cannot stand in for FD4 residual qualification.
rows.required_evidence: Current FD2 and FD4 manufactured solutions with matching residual operators, channel BCs, odd/noncubic shapes, nullspace/gauge and canaries.

rows.requirement: Complete resident pressure projection including boundaries/reference
rows.finding: Adapter connects RHS, local solver, Phi halos, corrections and deterministic reference in the coherent domain. Selected application passes strict primary and approved natural long-run qualification.
rows.required_evidence: Fresh public-build output/ledger reproduction; preserve transfer-reason evidence for the full producer/solve/consumer chain.

rows.requirement: Residency across RK stages/adaptive timesteps, scalar control and allocation reuse
rows.finding: Supported timestep path retains domains, computes CFL/averages on GPU, follows swaps and borrows domain-owned scratch.
rows.required_evidence: Current long/short reproduction plus non-output-step transfer ledger; do not claim zero transfers from kernel coverage.

rows.requirement: One budget for fields, scratch, solver plans/workspaces, graphs and output snapshots
rows.finding: Fields, scratch and provider workspace leases share runtime budget accounting. Full CUDA graph driver memory and future output snapshot budgeting require a complete inventory; no two-slot output implementation exists.
rows.required_evidence: Budget pressure/eviction tests including graphs and output slots; measure peak memory and retain latest values.

rows.requirement: Batch compatible kernels and replay stable graphs, external solver capture boundary
rows.finding: Runtime graph queue/replay and packed launch arguments are used by the selected build. External solver remains separately ordered. Graph measurement producer explicitly grants no placement authority.
rows.required_evidence: Fresh graph protocol observations and replay/update/lifetime regressions; fit and validate any automatic graph pricing separately.

rows.requirement: Dependency/numerical-safe fusion and measured kernel optimization
rows.finding: Private-scalar fusion and exact power-of-two division lower current numerical costs; measured failed address/geometry pilots were not promoted.
rows.required_evidence: Current public reproduction and retained arithmetic tests; future optimizations require measured complete-process benefit.

rows.requirement: Bounded asynchronous output: two immutable slots, ordered capture, DMA/write completion and join
rows.finding: Frame path currently observes field replicas synchronously before original D%Fill. This preserves correctness and device replicas, but does not implement asynchronous snapshots or writer backpressure.
rows.required_evidence: Implement at most two budgeted device/pinned slots and writer lifecycle; verify every output/frame, conflict ordering, full queue backpressure and final join.

rows.requirement: Remove duplicate policy/bridge/catalog/compatibility paths
rows.finding: Old bounded/reached modes are no longer public source-scope modes; duplicate vendored solver is removed. Public ordinary policies always/sections/auto/chunked/hybrid remain; production numerical preparation explicitly imports legacy configuration types. Private fixtures are not fully isolated from production.
rows.required_evidence: Replace ordinary policy matrix with one graph policy plus explicit CPU/GPU diagnostics; migrate or remove legacy proof/config consumers and give clear errors for removed options.

rows.requirement: Runtime ABI/manifests, full artifact regeneration and fresh calibrated costs
rows.finding: Full current public build and strict primary/approved long reproduction pass. Current base/runtime, transfer and physical-copy costs validate; collective AUTO holdout and three structural source-submit holdouts reject their optional models. All32 graph observation cases pass without placement authority. Complete automatic placement remains unqualified.
rows.required_evidence: Complete source and binary receipts, matching generated interfaces, validated current calibration; availability must reflect fit failures, never stale substitutes.

rows.requirement: All memory/failure/solver maintained suites at release milestone
rows.finding: Focused milestones passed, but previous broad compiler suite was interrupted after 878 passes and three stale-reader failures subsequently fixed. No complete current release-suite pass is established.
rows.required_evidence: Run maintained suites against current sources; preserve failures and distinguish private historical fixtures from supported production contracts.

rows.requirement: Natural109 and2458: all20 fields/bounds/halos/output, approved tolerances and four native threads
rows.finding: Selected index-conversion baseline passes strict primary and approved per-component 1% L2 long run. Worst long L2 .154896%; peak-scaled local pressure error 1.467061% remains reported. Structural/time checks unchanged.
rows.required_evidence: New public-build primary and natural long results, retaining historical strict failures and native reference identities.

rows.requirement: Fresh native/be58/7a/candidate timing with warmup/seven rotated complete-process samples
rows.finding: Recent valid three-variant campaign exceeds 2x native; latest increment wins 5/7 and6/7 pairs only. Historical four-control campaign remains separate; current release is not freshly compared against all four controls.
rows.required_evidence: Fresh four-control release campaign after implementation stabilizes; preserve all samples, load gates, separate profiles and paired/median claims.

rows.requirement: 20x research target or measured ceiling and remaining gap without workload changes
rows.finding: Current measured speedups3.83x/3.73x fall below20x. Profile kernel unions1.994/2.527s exceed entire target budgets. This is a ceiling for unchanged measured kernels, not a hardware impossibility proof.
rows.required_evidence: Publish gap continuously; pursue measured kernel/host/output changes without shortening primary cases or excluding startup/output.
